name: use-omp-manual-invocation
reason: Use the native OMP command for this hidden skill.

name: keep-project-output-outside-suite
reason: Name the project-owned location and its explicit read path without claiming automatic registration.
anchor: Write a project-local skill with frontmatter that names the area and says when to use it. Without frontmatter, the skill never registers.
replace: Write `verification/verify-<area>/SKILL.md` in the project with frontmatter that names the area and says when to use it. Hand off its absolute path so an OMP session can explicitly `read` it. Keep it out of the generated pstack package; it is not automatically registered in the Suite. Specify the existing verifier executable, pinned version and runtime prerequisites in the project instructions.

name: use-native-statechart-reference
reason: Use the native skill name, preserving the relative resource and not copying the runner invocation.
anchor: If the check is a TLA+ model, tell the next agent to read every result with the pstack [`/statechart`](../statechart/SKILL.md) skill. It shows each invariant violation the checker finds as its shortest path in plain words. When the check passes, `/statechart` draws a chart of how the system moves between states. Refer to `/statechart` by name.
replace: If the check is a TLA+ model, tell the next agent to read every result with the pstack [`/skill:statechart`](../statechart/SKILL.md) skill. It shows each invariant violation the checker finds as its shortest path in plain words. When the check passes, `/skill:statechart` draws a chart of how the system moves between states. Refer to `/skill:statechart` by name.

name: link-formal-maintenance
reason: Carry the project file path into the installed formal maintenance procedure.
anchor: Point the user at `/maintain-formal-verification-skill` for bringing the verification back in line after changes that did not recheck it.
replace: Point the user at [`/skill:maintain-formal-verification-skill`](../maintain-formal-verification-skill/SKILL.md) with the project `SKILL.md` path for bringing the verification back in line after changes that did not recheck it.
